convertibility_reason: Time-based open/close EA with no technical indicators. Uses only standard MQL5 trade functions (CTrade) and time comparisons. Simple entry/exit logic based on session time windows. No external libraries or custom indicators required.

other_exits: Time-based close: position is closed when current time passes the configured CloseTime for its day

custom_logic_notes: EA opens a position at a user-defined OpenHour:OpenMinute and closes it at a user-defined CloseHour:CloseMinute for each day of the week (Mon-Fri configurable independently). Long-only by default (buy positions). Each weekday has its own open/close time pair. Position is only opened if none already exists for that symbol. The close is triggered purely by time reaching the close threshold, not by signal reversal. SL/TP are set at order creation in points (not pips), with values like 400 and 600 points respectively. The EA uses CTrade for order execution and PositionSelect to check for existing positions.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Replace MQL5 TimeCurrent() with datetime.utcnow() or exchange time. Replace PositionSelect() with a position check via the trading API. CTrade.Send() maps directly to a market buy order. The per-weekday time configuration maps to a dict or list of {open_hour, open_minute, close_hour, close_minute} entries. SL/TP in points need conversion to the broker's point size. No indicator data needed — only time comparisons and position state checks.
